uz: Combined Cycle Power Plant (CCPP) bitta yoqilg'idan ikki marta energiya oladi: avval gaz, keyin bug' turbinasi orqali.
en: A Combined Cycle Power Plant extracts energy twice from one fuel: first via the gas turbine, then the steam turbine.

uz: Turbina rotori ideal balansda bo'lishi shart: 1 gramm nomutanosiblik 3000 ayl/min tezlikda kuchli vibratsiya beradi.
en: A turbine rotor must be perfectly balanced — even 1 gram of imbalance causes strong vibration at 3000 rpm.
